title: RBI monetary policy: Small digital fraud victims to get up to ₹25K refund
theme: RBI monetary policy: Small digital fraud victims to get up to ₹25K refund
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: RBI monetary policy: Small digital fraud victims to get up to ₹25K refund
constituentArticles.text: RBI MPC announced one-time compensation up to 85% of amount lost or ₹25,000 for small digital fraud victims: banks bear 15%, customer 15%, RBI/DEA fund bears 70%.
